title: Where did the speaker move?
hint: Answer in 1–3 words. Say the place the speaker moved to.

ja.prompt: 話者はどこに引っ越しましたか？
ja.hint: 1〜3語で答えてください。話者が引っ越した場所を答えましょう。

local.prompt: 話者はどこに引っ越しましたか？
local.hint: 1〜3語で答えてください。引っ越した場所を言いましょう。

local_pron.prompt: Waasya wa doko ni hikkoshimashita ka?
local_pron.hint: Ichi kara san-go de kotaete kudasai.

zh.hint: 用1到3个词回答。说出说话者搬到的地方。

en.hint: Answer in 1–3 words. Say the place the speaker moved to.

en_pron.hint: ˈɑːnsər ɪn wʌn tu θri wɜrdz

title: What can classmates do at lunch?
prompt: What can classmates do at lunch?
hint: Give a short sentence (3–7 words). Start with “We can” and say one lunchtime action.
sample: We can sit together at lunch.

ja.prompt: 昼休みにクラスメートは何ができますか？
ja.hint: 短い文（3〜7語）で答えてください。「We can」で始めて昼休みの行動を一つ言いましょう。
ja.sample: We can sit together at lunch.

local.prompt: 昼休みにクラスメートは何ができますか？
local.hint: 「We can」で始め、昼休みの一つの行動を短い文で答えてください。
local.sample: We can sit together at lunch.

local_pron.prompt: Hiruyasumi ni kurasumeeto wa nani ga dekimasu ka?
local_pron.sample: We can sit together at lunch.

zh.prompt: 同学们在午餐时可以做什么？
zh.hint: 用3到7个词的短句回答。以“We can”开头，说一件午餐时可以做的事。
zh.sample: We can sit together at lunch.

en.prompt: What can classmates do at lunch?
en.hint: Give a short sentence (3–7 words). Start with “We can” and say one lunchtime action.
en.sample: We can sit together at lunch.

en_pron.prompt: wʌt kæn ˈklæsˌmeɪts du æt lʌntʃ
en_pron.hint: gɪv ə ʃɔrt ˈsɛntəns, stɑrt wɪð 'wi kæn'
en_pron.sample: wi kæn sɪt təˈgɛðər æt lʌntʃ

title: How did the speaker make new friends?
prompt: What did the speaker do to make new friends?
hint: Answer with a short sentence about actions. Start with 'I' and mention both 'club' and 'lunch'.
sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

ja.prompt: 話者はどうやって新しい友達を作りましたか？
ja.hint: 行動についての短い文で答えてください。'I'で始め、『クラブ』と『昼休み』を両方含めてください。
ja.sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

local.prompt: 話者はどうやって新しい友達を作りましたか？
local.hint: 'I'で始め、『クラブ』と『昼休み』を入れた短い文で答えてください。
local.sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

local_pron.prompt: Waasya wa dou yatte atarashii tomodachi o tsukurimashita ka?
local_pron.hint: 'I' de hajimete 'club' to 'lunch' o irete kotaete kudasai.
local_pron.sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

zh.prompt: 说话者怎样交到新朋友？
zh.hint: 用一句关于行动的短句回答。以“I”开头，并提到“社团/俱乐部”和“午餐”。
zh.sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

en.prompt: What did the speaker do to make new friends?
en.hint: Answer with a short sentence about actions. Start with 'I' and mention both 'club' and 'lunch'.
en.sample: I joined a club and talked at lunch.

en_pron.prompt: wʌt dɪd ðə ˈspiːkər duː tu meɪk nuː frɛndz
en_pron.sample: aɪ dʒɔɪnd ə klʌb ænd tɔkt æt lʌntʃ
